CIERRE — CLOSURE REGISTER, ARCHIVED COPY
The last shift crossed out the heating schedule, one empty compartment at a time. Nobody signed for a replacement shift. The clerk left the column blank instead of writing zero.
The closing record says that the tug Estiba was withdrawn from service with the uncollected stores aboard. Its later condition and the whereabouts of the people are not recorded here.
The final task was to copy this register to Margen. The relay was set to repeat an archive, not to answer callers.
